title: Microsoft.Entra/groups
description: A security, Microsoft 365, dynamic or role-assignable group. The resource name is the Graph uniqueName. Mail-enabled security groups cannot be created through Graph (adopt only). Properties not listed here are passed through to Graph unchanged.

uniqueName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

mailEnabled.description: Required on create; immutable. True for Microsoft 365 groups.

mailNickname.description: Mail alias (up to 64 characters; none of @ ( ) \ [ ] " ; : . < > , or space). Derived from the name when omitted; can be changed later (Graph group update).

securityEnabled.description: Required on create. True for security groups.

groupTypes.description: [] security group, ["Unified"] Microsoft 365 group, plus "DynamicMembership" for dynamic groups. The Unified presence is immutable (no conversion between a security group and a Microsoft 365 group); DynamicMembership can be added or removed.

isAssignableToRole.description: Role-assignable group (immutable; never dynamic; securityEnabled must be true, and a Microsoft 365 group visibility Private - both defaulted on create; required for directoryRoles; up to 500 per tenant).

visibility.description: Public, Private or HiddenMembership. Public and Private can be changed later; HiddenMembership can only be set at creation and never changed.

membershipRule.description: Dynamic membership rule (requires groupTypes to contain DynamicMembership; Entra ID P1).

membershipRuleProcessingState.description: On (default for dynamic groups) or Paused.

members.description: Group membership edge, target side: the full desired set of member object ids (users, service principals, groups). Not allowed on dynamic groups; members not listed are removed.

owners.description: Ownership edge, target side: the full desired set of owner object ids (users, service principals). Authoritative: missing owners are added, live owners not listed are removed; absent leaves the owners untouched. An empty array is refused (Graph does not remove the last user owner of a group).

memberOf.description: Nested group membership edge, principal side: group object ids this group must be a member of.

administrativeUnits.description: Administrative unit membership edge, principal side: administrative unit object ids.

groupLifecyclePolicies.description: Group lifecycle (expiration) policy edge, principal side (ensure-only): the object id of the tenant's group lifecycle policy, whose managedGroupTypes must be Selected. Microsoft 365 groups only.

appRoleAssignments.description: App role assignment edge, principal side (applied by the edge pass, tracked in state): [{ resourceId | resourceAppId, appRole | appRoleId }]. appRole is the role's value, resolved against the resource service principal; 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 is default access.

resourceId.description: Object id of the resource service principal.

resourceAppId.description: Application (client) id of the resource; resolved to its service principal.

appRole.description: Value of the app role on the resource, for example Orders.Admin.

appRoleId.description: Id of the app role (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 = default access).

directoryRoles.description: Directory role assignment edge, principal side (role-assignable groups only) (applied by the edge pass, tracked in state): [{ role | roleDefinitionId, directoryScopeId | administrativeUnit }]. role is a role template id, a built-in role display name, a custom role display name or its id. The scope defaults to '/' (tenant).

role.description: Role template id, built-in role name (Global Reader), custom role display name or custom role id.

roleDefinitionId.description: The role template id (roleTemplate('Display Name')); use role for names.

administrativeUnit.description: Sugar for an administrative-unit scope: the unit's object id or its template name (reference('Orders AU').id).

assignedLicenses.description: Licenses for group-based licensing (action-backed, direct assignments only; group-inherited licenses are never touched): [{ skuId | skuPartNumber, disabledPlans }].

skuPartNumber.description: SKU part number, for example ENTERPRISEPREMIUM; resolved with GET /subscribedSkus.

disabledPlans.description: Service plan ids to disable within the SKU.
